title: EPIC: Efficient Position-Independent Caching for Serving Large Language Models
authors: Junhao Hu; Wenrui Huang; Weidong Wang; Haoyi Wang; Tiancheng Hu; Qin Zhang; Hao Feng; Xusheng Chen; Yizhou Shan; Tao Xie
affiliations: Peking University, Nanjing University, Huawei Cloud

problem_statement.en: Prefix-based context caching can reuse KV vectors only when requests share an exact prefix, so immutable documents and few-shot examples preceded by different content must be recomputed. Position-independent reuse increases cache opportunities but deviates from standard attention and can degrade accuracy.
problem_statement.zh: 以 prefix 為基礎的 context caching 僅能在 request 具有完全相同 prefix 時重用 KV 向量，因此，當 immutable document 或 few-shot example 前置不同內容時，仍須重新計算。position-independent reuse 雖可擴大 cache 重用機會，卻會偏離標準 attention 機制並造成準確率下降。

key_innovation.en: EPIC formalizes Position-Independent Caching as a compile–link framework: immutable chunks are compiled into independent KV caches and then assembled on demand. Its LegoLink algorithm uses a static positional heuristic to selectively recompute only the first k tokens (k ≤ 32) of each non-initial chunk, mitigating attention sinks with O(kN) rather than O(N²) recomputation.
key_innovation.zh: EPIC 將 Position-Independent Caching 形式化為 compile–link 兩階段框架：先把 immutable chunks 編譯為彼此獨立的 KV cache，再於 request 到達時進行組合。LegoLink 採用靜態 positional heuristic，僅選擇性重算每個非首個 chunk 的前 k 個 tokens（k ≤ 32），以 O(kN) 而非 O(N²) 的重算成本緩解 attention sink。

key_improvements.en: Compared with CacheBlend-15, LegoLink-16 reduces TTFT by up to 8× and raises throughput by up to 7× under asynchronous workloads; in synchronous workloads, LegoLink improves TTFT by up to 3× while limiting accuracy loss to within 7%.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 CacheBlend-15，LegoLink-16 在 asynchronous workload 下使 TTFT 最高降低 8×，並將 throughput 最高提升 7×；在 synchronous workload 下，LegoLink 的 TTFT 最高改善 3×，且準確率損失控制在 7% 以內。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-80GB, Intel Xeon Platinum 8358P, 1TB DRAM

reuse_metric.en: Across the evaluated datasets, immutable tokens constitute approximately 95%–99% of each prompt; EPIC reports negligible or no accuracy loss, with LegoLink-2 limiting accuracy drops to 0%–7%.
reuse_metric.zh: 在評測資料集中，immutable tokens 約占每個 prompt 的 95%–99%；EPIC 報告的準確率損失可忽略或為零，且 LegoLink-2 將準確率降幅控制在 0%–7%。
